physical: H = −Σ p × log p: the uncertainty of a source is minus the sum over outcomes of probability times log probability; the least average number of bits needed to encode it.
reflected_formula: [Shannon entropy H: no partner] = −Σ [probability p: no partner] × log [probability p: no partner]
reflected_sentence: The relationship keeps: the measure of uncertainty of a source is minus the sum over outcomes of each chance times the log of that chance, and neither the measure nor the chance has a frozen partner.
rule_reason: definition; Shannon entropy and probability are both fixed as measures that do not carry resistance, so zero resistance-costs and the shape keeps
interpretation: Nothing in this relation reaches the nonphysical side. Culmination is the partner of entropy, but the fixed list names Shannon entropy as a separate quantity, a measure of uncertainty, so I did not borrow Culmination for it.
closing: The rule decided on its own (definition, keeps). The one temptation was to map Shannon entropy onto Culmination through the entropy row; the fixed list treats them as different quantities, and being strict I left it unmapped. The formula is a sum; the trap about sums concerns introducing sums where the book has products, so keeping the physical sum is not a violation, but it also means a sum would be sitting on the nonphysical side if anything had crossed.
